description: A caching boundary around Data Access Layer queries that associates cached results with semantic tags like 'catalog-products' for targeted invalidation.
The practice of mapping raw database rows to explicit Data Transfer Objects inside the DAL so sensitive fields like supplierSecret never leak to the client.
Immediate synchronous cache expiration inside a Server Action so the subsequent read in the same mutation lifecycle returns freshly updated data.
A non-blocking callback scheduled during a Server Action or render that executes side effects such as audit logging after the response has been sent.
A parallel route slot combined with route interception that renders a product detail view inside an accessible dialog overlay without leaving the storefront page.
